field.label: Enable
field.help: Count each quota's host from pf's states once a minute, and block a host over its quota until its cycle starts again. Off by default. Off, nothing is counted, no host is blocked, and the alias quota_over leaves Firewall: Aliases - switched off instead where a rule or a setting still names it. The counts of the cycle are kept.

field.label: Minute of use above (KB)
field.help: A time quota counts minutes of use: a minute of the clock in which the host moved more than this many kilobytes, both ways together (1 KB = 1,000 bytes), so a device that only keeps itself connected in the background uses none. 0: any byte makes a minute of use. Empty: the plugin's own value, 100 KB in this release - a first value, until a measurement of idle devices sets it; left empty, a later release's value applies.
